newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Randstad optimistic on current year.
newsitem.headline: Randstad optimistic on current year.

text.p: Temporary employment agency Randstad Holding NV said on Friday it was optimistic on its prospects for the current year, as well as in the longer term.
"For both the shorter and the longer term, the direction is optimistic over the development of the markets in which Randstad is active," the company said in a statement.
It said it expected an average annual ten percent market growth in the longer term.

The company earlier posted 1996 net profit of 207.4 million guilders, up 27 percent from 1995's 163.3 million. Randstad said in January it expected 1996 turnover and profits to have grown by about 25 percent.
